headline: The top 10 most expensive neighborhoods in the country consists of 8 zones in Bucharest and one each in Cluj-Napoca and Brasov, with the capital leading with maximum prices exceeding the threshold of 5,500 euros/sq m of usable area
summary: Eight of Romania's ten most expensive neighborhoods are in Bucharest, with one each in Cluj-Napoca and Brasov. The capital's top zones exceed 5,500 euros per square metre of usable area.
why: Residential property prices reflect household wealth, mortgage conditions and demand in Romania's largest cities. They matter for real estate investors and lenders.
